titulo.es: Groenlandia: Trump concluye un acuerdo con Dinamarca por el que tendrá "control permanente" en la isla
titulo.en: South Korea will not send military to support US war on Iran, defying Trump pressure

sintesis.es: El presidente estadounidense Donald Trump anunció, el viernes 18 de septiembre, la conclusión de un acuerdo con Dinamarca y Groenlandia que debe permitir a Estados Unidos reforzar su presencia militar en la isla. Afirma que Washington ha obtenido un "control permanente" sobre la seguridad del territorio y que el acuerdo impedirá que cualquier "adversario" de Estados Unidos establezca allí una presencia militar o realice inversiones sensibles.
sintesis.en: Seoul resolves recent speculation over sending military to strait of Hormuz, saying ‘there won’t be deployment that would involve or enter war’ South Korea’s president, Lee Jae Myung, has said he will ⁠not deploy the military to the ⁠Middle East in a way ​that could draw the country into conflict, resisting calls from Donald Trump to support his war in Iran. “There won’t be deployment that would involve or enter war. I can tell you that very clearly,” Lee said at a ⁠news conference on Friday.

titulo.es: Irán y los hutíes escalan la tensión en Oriente Próximo mientras EE.UU. se retira del conflicto
titulo.en: Iran and Houthis escalate Middle East tensions as US steps back from the conflict

sintesis.es: Irán refuerza su control sobre los estrechos de Ormuz y Bab el Mandeb, este último ahora en manos de los hutíes, mientras Estados Unidos evita involucrarse pese a su alianza histórica con Arabia Saudí. Riad activó alertas por una 'amenaza aérea hostil' y ataques hutíes se intensifican, llevando a embajadas estadounidenses a emitir avisos de seguridad. Turquía ofreció apoyo militar a Arabia Saudí, mientras Irán exige el fin del bloqueo naval de EE.UU. y de la guerra en todos los frentes como condición para negociar.
sintesis.en: Iran is tightening control over the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el Mandeb, the latter now held by Houthi forces, while the United States avoids involvement despite its longstanding alliance with Saudi Arabia. Riyadh activated alerts over a 'hostile aerial threat' as Houthi attacks intensify, prompting US embassies to issue security warnings. Turkey offered military support to Saudi Arabia, while Iran demands an end to the US naval blockade and all-front war as conditions for talks.

titulo.es: Guterres: el viejo orden mundial debe cambiar ante el avance de las economías emergentes
titulo.en: New mesothelioma drug turns cancer’s own defenses against it

sintesis.es: El titular de la ONU pide una profunda reforma de las instituciones internacionales para adaptarlas a las nuevas realidades económicas y geopolíticas, durante la cumbre de los BRICS en Nueva Delhi. Guterres destaca el avance hacia un mundo multipolar y reclama cambios en organismos como el Consejo de Seguridad y el sistema de Bretton Woods.
sintesis.en: Scientists are testing a counterintuitive way to fight mesothelioma, an aggressive asbestos-linked cancer with few effective treatments. A new experimental mesothelioma drug kills cancer cells by disabling PRX3, an antioxidant defense that tumors use to survive intense oxidative stress. In an early clinical trial, it controlled disease progression in 67% of patients and produced encouraging survival results, raising hopes that the strategy could eventually be used against other cancers.

titulo.es: Macron visits remote French territory in the North America, a first in over a decade
titulo.en: Macron visits remote French territory in the North America, a first in over a decade

sintesis.es: President Emmanuel Macron embarks on a rare and symbolic visit to a remote French territory in the North Atlantic on Saturday, hosting Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney at a time of growing tensions with Washington. The three-day visit to Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a three-island archipelago of under 6,000 people just off Newfoundland, will be the first by a French president in over a decade. Peter O'Brien tells us more about France's only remaining possession in North America.

titulo.es: Más de 30 muertos en una comisaría de Pakistán en un ataque terrorista talibán
titulo.en: How the malaria parasite boosts its transmission potential under stress conditions

sintesis.es: Un ataque con explosivos y armas de fuego contra un cuartel general de la policía en el norte de Pakistán, reivindicado por un grupo islamista armado, dejó al menos 31 muertos, entre ellos 16 policías. Los combates continuaban este sábado.
sintesis.en: The malaria parasite is able to detect changes in its host's environment and respond by increasing the production of sexual forms capable of being transmitted to mosquitoes. A study led by the Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) identifies the molecular mechanism underlying this process. The findings, published in Nature Microbiology, answer what has been one of the major unanswered questions in malaria research for decades.

titulo.es: Bolivia elimina el subsidio al diésel tras aprobar crédito con el FMI
titulo.en: Bolivia eliminates diesel subsidy after approving IMF loan

sintesis.es: El Congreso de Bolivia aprobó un crédito de 1.900 millones de dólares con el FMI, condicionado a la eliminación de las subvenciones a los combustibles. Tras la aprobación, el presidente Rodrigo Paz anunció el fin total del subsidio al diésel, que ahora se cotiza a precio internacional, mientras se anunciaron medidas para amortiguar el impacto. El acuerdo, pendiente de aprobación final del FMI, contempla la eliminación de todos los subsidios a combustibles a partir de 2027 y podría abrir nuevas líneas de financiamiento con otras instituciones como el Banco Mundial.
sintesis.en: Bolivia's Congress approved a $1.9 billion loan from the IMF, conditioned on eliminating fuel subsidies. Following approval, President Rodrigo Paz announced the total elimination of the diesel subsidy, which now trades at international prices, while announcing measures to cushion the impact. The agreement, pending final IMF approval, calls for eliminating all fuel subsidies by 2027 and could open new financing lines with institutions like the World Bank.

sintesis.es: The World Health Organization (WHO) has certified Timor-Leste as malaria-free, a remarkable achievement for a country that prioritized the disease and embarked on a concerted, nation-wide response shortly after gaining independence in 2002. “WHO congratulates the people and government of Timor-Leste on this significant milestone,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General. “Timor-Leste’s success proves that malaria can be stopped in its tracks when strong political will, smart interventions, sustained domestic and external investment and dedicated health workers unite.” With today’s announcement, a total of 47 countries and 1 territory have been certified as malaria-free by WHO.
